meta.pos: verb; verb; noun; noun; noun; adj

defs.def: to experience sth, especially sth unpleasant or difficult, while you are trying to do sth else 遭遇，遇到（尤指令人不快或困难的事）

ex.s: But for me, it was the first challenge I encountered as an international student in Ireland.
ex.t: 但对我来说，这是我作为国际学生在爱尔兰遇到的第一个挑战。

ex.s: This makes sense because the people who get observational biodiversity data on mobile devices are often citizen scientists recording their encounters with species in areas nearby.
ex.t: 这样做是有道理的，因为在移动设备上获得观测生物多样性数据的人往往是公民科学家，记录他们在附近地区与物种的遭遇。

ex.s: You’ll hear these participants’ stories and learn what strategies worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.
ex.t: 你将听到这些参与者的故事，了解哪些策略对他们有效，以及他们遇到了哪些你应当避免的陷阱。

ex.s: And above all, stories have a transformative power to allow us to see the world in a different way than we do if we just encounter it on our own.
ex.t: 而最重要的是，故事具有一种变革性的力量，能让我们以不同于独自面对世界时所采用的方式去看待世界。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: （10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

ex.s: Nutria are an endangered species.
ex.t: 海狸鼠是濒危物种。

ex.s: In the course of this life, I have had a great many encounters with a great many people who have been concerned with matters of consequence.
ex.t: 在我这一生中，我遇到过许多关心重要事情的人。

ex.s: Talk about another phenomenon of the global village using the expressions in this section.] Now think about any difficulties you encountered during your discussion and what you did to overcome them.
ex.t: 用这一部分的表达方式谈谈地球村的另一个现象。] 现在想想你在讨论中遇到的任何困难以及你是如何克服它们的。

ex.s: Which of these do you most expect to encounter in your lifetime?
ex.t: 这些中哪一项你最希望在自己的一生中遇到？

ex.s: So, whatever twists and turns you might encounter, take a leaf out of the books of these two authors and be prepared for the unexpected.
ex.t: 所以，无论你可能会遇到怎样的曲折坎坷，向这两位作家的书学习，为意想不到的事情做好准备。

defs.def: to meet sb, or discover or experience sth, especially sb/sth new, unusual or unexpected 偶然碰到；意外地遇见；与 … 邂逅

ex.s: These include encountering wildlife, walking along the edge of water, and following an established trail.
ex.t: 这些类别包括遇见野生动物、沿着水边散步，以及沿着既有的小径行走。

ex.s: Readers will encounter not only stories they have heard before, but some new stories and a moving discussion of the responsibility of the engineer to the public and the ways young engineers can be helped to grasp them.
ex.t: 读者不仅会读到他们以前听过的故事，还会读到一些新故事，以及关于工程师对公众的责任、以及如何帮助年轻工程师理解这些责任的感人讨论。

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。

defs.def: a meeting, especially one that is sudden, unexpected or violent （尤指突然、意外或暴力的）相遇，邂逅，遭遇，冲突

ex.s: According to the World Wildlife Fund, the global black rhino population has dropped as low as 5500, giving the rhinos a “critically endangered” status.
ex.t: 根据世界自然基金会，全球黑犀牛数量已降至低至5500头，使犀牛处于极危状态。

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

defs.def: a sports match against a particular player or team （体育）比赛，交锋
an incident in which police shoot dead a suspected criminal 警察击毙嫌疑犯事件

ex.s: Preserve the genes of endangered plants.
ex.t: 保护濒危植物的基因。

ex.s: Even though we have other valuable things endangered by climate change, like food access, there is also an element of cultural identity, cultural survival, and history.
ex.t: 尽管我们还有其他因气候变化而受到威胁的宝贵事物，比如食物获取，但这里也有文化认同、文化存续和历史的元素。

ex.s: In 1975, grizzlies were listed under the Endangered Species Act.
ex.t: 1975年，灰熊被列入《濒危物种法》保护名录。
